name: Medinex Limited
summary: Medinex Limited, an investment holding company, provides professional medical support and consultancy services to medical clinics in Singapore. The company operates through three segments: Medical Support Services, Business Support Services, and Pharmaceutical Services. Its medical support services include overseeing the setting up of clinics; and facilitating applications for relevant clinic licenses. The company also provides business support services, such as accounting and tax agent services, human resource management services, and corporate secretarial services. In addition, it offers pharmaceutical services, such as assistance in procuring medical and pharmaceutical products, as well as business support services to companies outside of the healthcare industry. It primarily serves general practitioners and specialists; and clients in various industries, including food and beverage, retail, education, and beauty industries. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Singapore.
